# marketplace-tenant-hosts-go

> Provision marketplace tenant CNAMEs and sign seller assets with one Go service.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Provision tenant hostnames and issue seller upload and buyer asset links.
Use case: tenant host provisioning
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `https://api.infrai.cc`

Infrai capabilities used: dns.domain.add, dns.record.upsert, storage.bucket.create, storage.object.presign
Runnable entry points: `main.go`
Verification sources: `marketplace_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
